note: Consumer map for the wink verification contract (v0.2). This app keeps most recorded selectors (.cta, .brand, .badge, .btn) but names other surfaces its own way; the map lets the contract engage it. Context + adjudication: design-authority docs/experiments/06-consumer-flow-wink-calendar.md.

ignore.wink/progress-ring: no progress display in this app
ignore.wink/badge-shape: the badge renders only inside an all-day agenda row; verifier fixtures for seeded states are not yet supported
ignore.wink/ledger-head: the day agenda composes ledger rows without a table header
ignore.wink/status-words: no status widget in this app
ignore.wink/tick-marked: review-instrument mark; consumer builds do not ship it
ignore.wink/no-floating-surfaces: the check's interaction fixture (.log-tick double-toggle) is reference-specific; the app's overlays were verified hidden at rest (see experiment doc 06)
ignore.wink/destructive-not-focused: the app's confirm opens from inside the edit dialog; the check's default-view trigger and native-dialog assumptions cannot drive it (see experiment doc 06)
